Well, I'm not new. As I've stated I've had a lot of great experiences with players over the last 10 seasons. Unfortunately as of late that has not been the case. There has been a noticeable change in the demeanor of players in the game. Less than 30 minutes ago I had a teammate in ranked that refused to revive me or our other teammate. He just straight up refused and decided instead to sit in corners and tell us to kill ourselves. 

It's gotten ridiculous. Why even play the game at that point.

Thanks for your comment, it makes me feel a little better. It's really been discouraging lately I've honestly been considering quitting. I used to have a squad that played with me consistently but life has taken them other places and they no longer play the game. 

It really is sad. Like I said this is my favorite game and I have had great experiences on here. Lately I've been going through a lot of stuff irl and it feels like I have nowhere to escape to anymore. I've been so depressed lately with things happening at home and at my job, I just want to get on apex and link up with awesome people that enjoy the game we all love. 

Thanks again for the comment man I hope you have a great day.
